title.en: Crusoe says Google acquired its Wyoming data-center site
title.zhHans: Crusoe 称谷歌已收购其怀俄明州数据中心地块

searchSummary.en: Crusoe reported a completed Google site acquisition on November 6; Google’s separately announced $17 billion investment is a long-term plan.
searchSummary.zhHans: Crusoe 于 11 月 6 日报告谷歌已收购该地块；谷歌另行宣布的 170 亿美元投资是长期计划。

summary.en: On November 6, Crusoe announced that Google had acquired its pre-developed Wyoming data-center site. Google’s November 5 article described a long-term $17 billion investment in its first Wyoming data center. The site transfer is a company-reported completed transaction; the full campus, funding and promised power, jobs and carbon-capture work are not established as completed. Both companies are transaction participants, not independent audits of project delivery.
summary.zhHans: Crusoe 于 11 月 6 日宣布，谷歌已收购其前期开发的怀俄明州数据中心地块。谷歌 11 月 5 日的文章将当地首座数据中心描述为 170 亿美元的长期投资计划。地块转让是交易方报告的已完成事项；园区建成、资金全部投入以及供电、就业和碳捕集等承诺尚未得到完成验证。两家公司的声明都来自交易参与方，不构成项目落地的独立审计。

narrative.en: This is the disclosure of a site transfer, not evidence that Google paid $17 billion or that commercial data-center service has begun. Google announced its investment plan one day earlier; Crusoe’s release is a distinct completed acquisition stage.
narrative.zhHans: 本节点记录地块转让的披露，不证明谷歌已支付 170 亿美元或数据中心已投入商业运营。谷歌一天前宣布投资计划，Crusoe 的公告记录的是不同的地块收购完成阶段。

text.en: Crusoe reported on November 6 that Google had acquired its Wyoming site; Google had announced a long-term $17 billion investment plan on November 5.
text.zhHans: Crusoe 于 11 月 6 日报告谷歌已收购其怀俄明州地块；谷歌于 11 月 5 日宣布长期 170 亿美元投资计划。

text.en: A completed site transfer does not establish that $17 billion was paid, a full data center opened or planned energy and jobs materialized.
text.zhHans: 地块转让完成不等于 170 亿美元已经支付、整座数据中心投入运营，或所规划的能源与就业效果已兑现。
